abstract: BackgroundUpfront resection with adjuvant chemotherapy remains standard for resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), but a quarter or more of patients never start adjuvant therapy. We assessed readiness for adjuvant therapy within 12 weeks of upfront pancreatectomy, its correlates, and how often ready patients went untreated.MethodsWe reviewed 114 consecutive upfront pancreatectomies for PDAC at a high-volume centre (2017-2023). The primary endpoint was clinician-documented readiness for adjuvant chemotherapy within 12 weeks; initiation was secondary. The same oncologist usually documented both, so they are not independent. A burden score counted five adverse recovery events by day 30.ResultsOf 107 assessed patients, 89 (83.2%, 95% CI 74.7-89.7) were ready within 12 weeks (87.3% excluding 5 who died or had metastatic disease). Readiness was 94.6% with no adverse event, 82.4% with one, and 68.8% with two or more (non-readiness vs none: OR 7.1, 95% CI 2.1-30.5). Clinically relevant pancreatic fistula alone showed no association (OR 1.15, 95% CI 0.36-3.33; 5 events), but a clinically important effect could not be excluded. The burden score had an internally estimated AUC of 0.73 (95% CI 0.59-0.85). Only 54 (50.5%) started chemotherapy within 12 weeks, including 53 of 88 ready patients.DiscussionMost patients were ready for adjuvant therapy within 12 weeks, and failure to recover tracked cumulative postoperative burden by day 30. Over a third of ready patients had no documented chemotherapy start, although readiness and initiation were not independently assessed. These hypothesis-generating findings require external validation and do not compare treatment sequencing.
key_points_ko: 수술 후 환자의 83.2%(107명 중 89명)가 12주 이내에 보조항암치료를 시작할 신체적 준비가 되었습니다.
수술 후 30일 내 합병증 등 이상 사건이 없었던 경우 준비율은 94.6%였으나, 2개 이상인 경우 68.8%로 저하되었습니다(오즈비 7.1).
치료 준비가 완료된 환자 중에서도 상당수가 치료를 받지 못하여, 12주 내 실제 보조항암치료를 시작한 환자는 전체의 50.5%(54명)였습니다.
summary_ko: 수술 가능한 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자가 수술 후 12주 이내에 보조항암치료(adjuvant chemotherapy)를 받을 준비가 되는 비율과 실제 치료 시작 현황을 분석한 후향적 관찰 연구입니다. 단일 대형 센터에서 수술을 받은 환자 107명 중 89명(83.2%)이 12주 이내에 항암치료를 시작할 준비가 된 것으로 평가되었습니다. 수술 후 30일 이내에 발생한 이상 사건(합병증 등)이 많을수록 준비 완료율이 크게 감소했습니다. 그러나 항암치료를 받을 준비가 되었음에도 3분의 1 이상의 환자는 실제 치료를 시작하지 않아, 12주 이내 치료 시작률은 50.5%(54명)에 머물렀습니다.
title: Recovery to Intended Oncologic Therapy After Upfront Pancreatectomy for Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 췌관선암 환자에서 선행 수술 후 계획된 보조항암치료 준비 상태 및 치료 시작률 분석
